reasons.plausibility: Adding Al to CoCrFeNi-based HEAs for strengthening, creep resistance, and oxide-layer corrosion protection is scientifically plausible, though there is some uncertainty about undesirable brittle phases at high Al contents.
reasons.testability: The hypothesis outlines well-defined tensile, creep, and corrosion tests with clear success/failure criteria, making it practically testable and capable of being falsified.
reasons.usefulness: Targeting Al content to boost multiple properties in aerospace fasteners is directly relevant and potentially impactful, though the optimal Al level may need further refinement.
